# Visible.vc

> Visible.vc is a founder-friendly investor relations hub that streamlines capital raising, investor communications, and portfolio management through integrated tools for pitch decks, data rooms, investor updates, and financial dashboards.

Visible.vc serves both founders and investors with a comprehensive platform for fundraising, investor relations, and portfolio monitoring. The platform combines CRM capabilities, secure document sharing, investor update templates, and real-time metrics tracking to facilitate better communication between founders and their investors.

## Key Topics
